_meta.description: Updated Stage 4 (Delivering) for the universal Anaplan product Delivery journey template. Slots into the larger template at stages[3]. Reflects iteration from Stage 4 review pass.
changes_from_previous: Preserved: Three-co-delivery progression (PS-primed → Partner-primed → Partner-led) with increasing partner ownership. Each engagement is tracked and measured.
Reframed: PS role is ADVISORY, not co-delivery. PS reviews artifacts and provides input. Tracks engagement progression but does not deliver alongside.
Replaced: Per-project documentation tasks (1 week each) — the artifacts ARE the documentation
Removed: Per-project CSAT gates (CSAT not measurable at this phase)
Removed: Capstone retrospective at end of stage
Removed: Engagement scoping and discovery exposure task (retired — implicitly covered by being on real engagements)
Removed: SA scorecard task and gate (retired — artifact gates and engagement completion gates are sufficient verification)

Added: Six artifact types mapped to methodology phases 5-10 (design doc, customer data review, configuration review, list/hierarchy review, extensions review, app-led workshop readiness). Each artifact is reviewed by the PSM as advisory checkpoint.
Added: Model B artifact-to-engagement cardinality — PS-primed engagement requires 2 artifacts, Partner-primed requires 4, Partner-led requires the full 6. Mirrors increasing partner ownership.
Decision: PSM coordinates all artifact reviews — Stage 4 is explicitly white-glove territory
Decision: No Stage 4 on-ramp — stage starts when participant submits first artifact in PS-primed engagement
Decision: Engagement completion gates kept alongside artifact gates — engagement going live with customer is distinct from artifact production
open_items_parked_for_later: Per-artifact review rubric — what specifically the PSM reviews each artifact against. Per-product authoring obligation.
PSM review SLA — how long a PSM has to return advisory feedback on a submitted artifact
PSM review load — operational implication of ~12 advisory reviews per participant per Stage 4. May need PSM-to-participant ratio guidance.
Engagement completion criteria — what specifically defines 'engagement complete' (go-live, signoff, hypercare end, etc.) — likely a separate engagement lifecycle definition
Artifact resubmission policy — what happens when PSM advisory review identifies issues. Default: revise and resubmit, no attempt limit.
What if no engagement is available — long-tail partners may stall in Stage 4 due to lack of engagement opportunities. Program-level concern.
_meta.boundary_with_stage_5: End of Stage 4: participant has completed three real client engagements with progressively increasing ownership (PS-primed → Partner-primed → Partner-led), produced and had reviewed 12 client artifacts across the three engagements, and demonstrated competency on real customer work. Stage 5 (Expert) covers ongoing independent delivery, blueprint contribution, mentorship, and adjacent-product credentialing.
_meta.stage_assumption: Stage 4 is white-glove. Partners reaching this stage have an active PSM relationship. Long-tail self-serve partners typically progress no further than Stage 3.

_note: Stage 4 task structure is FIXED across all product journeys. Artifact content varies by client engagement (real customer data and scenarios), but the artifact types, ownership progression, and review process are universal.
name: Delivering
description: Participant completes three real client engagements with progressively increasing ownership — PS-primed, Partner-primed, Partner-led. Within each engagement, participant produces structured artifacts at methodology checkpoints. PSM coordinates advisory review of all artifacts. Engagement completion is tracked separately from artifact completion.

engagements.ownership_description: PS leads engagement; partner observes and contributes. Participant focuses on absorbing how PS structures the methodology in a live customer setting, with a small artifact subset to anchor early learning.

Partner leads engagement; PS advises. Participant takes primary responsibility for engagement direction, with PSM advisory input on artifacts. Artifact subset expands to include configuration and validation activities.
Partner runs the engagement; PS on call. Participant produces the full artifact set across all six methodology phases, demonstrating end-to-end delivery competency.

_artifact_type_catalog.description: Six artifact types map to methodology phases 5-10 from Stage 2 Block C. Each artifact is a real client work product reviewed by the PSM as an advisory checkpoint.

types.title: Initial design document
types.description: Partner's design for the application configuration on the client engagement, submitted to PSM prior to configuration build.

types.title: Customer data review
types.description: Partner's review and validation of customer data files prior to running the configurator. PSM reviews data quality and readiness.

types.title: Configuration review
types.description: Partner's submitted configured application for advisory review. PSM reviews against design intent and product best practices.

types.title: List and hierarchy review
types.description: Partner's submitted lists and hierarchies for validation. PSM reviews structure, completeness, and alignment with customer data.

types.title: Extensions review
types.description: Partner's identified extensions on the engagement, reviewed by PSM for approach and feasibility before build begins.

types.title: Application-led workshop readiness
types.description: Partner's facilitation plan and materials for the customer-facing application-led workshop. PSM reviews readiness and provides advisory input.

tasks.title: Co-delivery Engagement 1 — PS-primed (PS leads, partner contributes)
tasks.description: First real client engagement. PS leads the methodology while partner observes, contributes, and produces 2 artifacts for PSM advisory review.
tasks._completion_mechanism_note: PSM signs off on engagement completion when customer engagement is delivered and live.

tasks.title: Engagement 1 — Submit design document for PSM review
tasks.description: Submit initial design document for the client engagement to PSM for advisory review.
tasks._completion_mechanism_note: PSM signs off after advisory review (revise-and-resubmit allowed).

tasks.title: Engagement 1 — Submit customer data review for PSM review
tasks.description: Submit customer data files and the partner's data review/validation to PSM for advisory review prior to running the configurator.

tasks.title: Co-delivery Engagement 2 — Partner-primed (partner leads, PS advises)
tasks.description: Second real client engagement. Partner takes primary engagement ownership; PS provides advisory input. Partner produces 4 artifacts for PSM review.

tasks.description: Third real client engagement. Partner runs end-to-end delivery; PS available on call. Partner produces the full set of 6 artifacts demonstrating complete delivery competency.

estimated_effort_total: 24-48 weeks engagement duration (3 × 8-16 weeks); ~12 PSM advisory reviews; participant time embedded in engagement delivery, not additive
_estimated_effort_total_note: Stage 4 elapsed time is bound by real engagement availability and customer pace. Realistic Stage 4 duration: 12-24+ months for active partners; longer or stalled for lower-pipeline partners.

_per_product_authoring_obligations.description: Stage 4 has no per-product asset authoring (no courses, recordings, or labs). Per-product authoring is review rubric definition.

items.scope: For each of the six artifact types, define what the PSM is reviewing against — required content, quality bar, common issues. Same rubrics apply across all engagements within a product journey.

items: PSM review load: ~12 advisory reviews per participant. Operational ratio of PSMs to active Stage 4 participants needs to be sustainable.
Engagement availability: a participant cannot progress through Stage 4 without three available client engagements at the partner firm. Partners with thin pipeline may stall here.
Review SLA: time PSM has to return advisory feedback. Default v0: TBD. Affects participant velocity through Stage 4.
Artifact resubmission: default v0 is revise-and-resubmit with no attempt limit. PSM advisory feedback drives revision.
